item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q020_syntaxin_fragment_reclassification","answer":"In SCOPe 2.08, 1br0 and 1ez3 should be read as syntaxin-1A N-terminal-domain fragment templates, not as independent evidence for a different syntaxin biology. SCOPe assigns d1br0a_ and the three 1ez3 chains d1ez3a_, d1ez3b_, and d1ez3c_ to a.47.2.1, with the protein node “Syntaxin 1A N-terminal domain”, family “t-snare proteins”, superfamily “t-snare proteins”, fold a.47 “STAT-like”, class a, all-alpha proteins. The fuller 1dn1 syntaxin chain B is also classified as a.47.2.1 in the same t-SNARE family/superfamily/fold, but in current SCOPe it appears as d1dn1b_ under an “automated matches” protein node; 1dn1 chain A is a separate e.25.1.1 Syntaxin-binding protein-1/Sec1-like domain and should not be merged with the syntaxin assignment. Biologically, a hit to the short 1br0/1ez3 fragments is therefore valid only as local evidence for the syntaxin-1A N-terminal three-helix STAT-like/t-SNARE domain. It should not be used by itself to transfer whole-chain architecture, the Sec1-binding complex context seen in 1dn1, transmembrane or SNARE-fusion annotations from other syntaxin regions, or representative status for the complete cytoplasmic syntaxin molecule; the full-length chain-B template, or the non-obsolete 3c98 successor to obsolete 1dn1, is the safer structural context for those broader interpretations.","evidence_used":["/api/v1","/api/v1/releases","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1br0","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1ez3","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1dn1","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1br0/domains","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1ez3/domains","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1dn1/domains","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/302344","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47663","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47662","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47661","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47654","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/191190","/api/v1/sequences/sids/d1br0a_?release=2.08","/api/v1/sequences/sids/d1ez3a_?release=2.08","/api/v1/sequences/sids/d1dn1b_?release=2.08","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1dn1/chains"]}]}
